control_plane_hardening_item_for_the_mai.statement: A lane whose namespace contains its own state/<lane>.json copy can write a correct-looking update to the wrong file and silently fail every post-producer validation, because the workflow reads exactly one path and nothing forbids the second. Two mitigations, neither applied here: (a) have the producer write scope explicitly exclude '*/*/state/<lane>.json' so the wrong target is caught by the EXISTING step 9 rather than by nothing; (b) have step 9 run before the aborting step, or make step 7 report the path it read so a failure names the file it wanted.
control_plane_hardening_item_for_the_mai.why_now: two consecutive cycles (39160544615, 39163970477) were lost to it and both were productive, so the cost is real and repeatable rather than hypothetical.
